fields: Penny! Rascal! What a pleasant surprise!
Oh come now, Finley! You know why we’re here!
Also how dare you send Rascal out on a menial task like a booty call. You know you can just ring me!
No no! It’s not like that!
I just wanted to show him your dexterous-
Yes yes, my dexterous and skilled talons.
Actually… I was kind of hoping for a beakjob today…
Haha, come on Penny, I know you want to show Rascal just as much as I do.
I do, I’m just messing with you.
Hard already? I was going to show Rascal how I fluff…
Heh, you should see it when I thrust! This position doesn’t do me justice…
Ok big guy, let’s commence this "demo!"
First, I like to get him all slicked up…
Ooo, see how she’s using her beak to stroke it too? It gets so smooth and slick…
Yeah, your whole shaft is glistening now.
Damn Finley, you’ve got a lot of pre!
Heh… Yeah I get that a lot…
He’s quite a messy boy! Don’t mind if I sample some from the tap…
Ah! This! I love this. She can nibble so gently…
Haha, just keeping you on your toes…
Plus I love making you twitch…
Gah! She’s evil Rascal. An absolute demon.
What can I say? I get testy when I’m hungry…
I’ll say! Looks like a perfect fit!
Mmm… She can take me to the hilt if we were in a different position…
Oh she’s getting even further down!
Ah… Hah… Penny dear, no need to show off…
See Rascal… Her beak’s smooth but hard edges… pressing around… ah…
This… is going to be a quick… demonstration…
Damn dude, you were pent up.
Ah- she… she keeps it deep in there…
*She gives Rascal a sly wink before pulling back*
Gah! Damn… I really needed that…
Er, I mean… That’s the end of the demonstration…
Yeah I thought so. You know you don’t need an excuse to fool around with me.
Haha, it wasn’t! I really wanted to show Rascal there’s nothing to fear with your assets.
You’ve converted me! I’m team bird all the way!
Hah, is that so? Then why not get your first taste of beak…
